REPRODUCIBLE EXPERIMENT

PDF Artifact Compression Lab

Compile a baseline and an optimized variant from the same source, then compare size, timing, and artifact treatment.

LOCAL WASM
01 SOURCE→02 BASELINE→03 OPTIMIZE→04 COMPARE
Uses pdfTeX stream level 9 and object-stream level 3. Text and vector graphics are unchanged.
Artifact policyPreserve text + vectorsRaster recompression will be tested separately with measurable quality thresholds.

WHY TWO BUILDS?

The experiment changes one factor—the PDF compression directives—while holding the LaTeX source and engine constant. This makes the result repeatable and suitable for later comparison with raster-image artifact metrics.
